configure_optuna_sweeper: configure the OptunaSweeperConf dataclass to set n_trials, n_jobs, direction, and storage for hyperparameter optimization
configure_tpe_sampler: configure the TPESamplerConfig dataclass to set seed, n_startup_trials, and n_ei_candidates for TPE sampling
configure_cmaes_sampler: configure the CmaEsSamplerConfig dataclass to set x0, sigma0, and inc_popsize for CMA-ES sampling
configure_distribution: configure the DistributionConfig dataclass to define int, float, or categorical search space distributions with bounds
register_sampler_config: register a sampler config class with Hydra ConfigStore under the hydra/sweeper/sampler group
